meta.filePurpose: Static, non-secret UI copy and state-to-display map for the future local React/Vite StitchCheck demo. No credentials, no live service data, no external content.
meta.allDataSynthetic: All displayed data is synthetic and local unless specifically labelled as the existing temporary OpenRouter extraction evidence. OpenRouter evidence is not direct Gemini validation. Local risk and alternatives placeholders are not live service data.

labels.geminiExtraction: OpenRouter temporary path — not direct Gemini validation
labels.nosanaRisk: Synthetic local placeholder — not Nosana evidence
labels.atlasAlternatives: Synthetic local placeholder — not Atlas Sandbox evidence

states.heading: StitchCheck — Synthetic Demo
states.body: This is a synthetic demo application. All data displayed is fictional and local. No real personal data, booking references, payment information, or live service evidence is used. Do not upload real documents. All screenshots must be synthetic and unbooked.

primaryAction.label: I understand — continue with synthetic data

states.accessibilityHint: Landing screen with synthetic-demo safety notice. User must acknowledge before proceeding.
states.safetyConstraint: No real PII accepted. No external calls. No service claims. This notice must remain visible until acknowledged.

states.heading: Upload Synthetic Screenshots
states.body: Select or upload exactly two synthetic, unbooked flight-ticket or checkout screenshots. These must be fictional images only — no real bookings, no real passenger data. Existing extraction evidence was produced via a temporary OpenRouter path, not direct Gemini validation.
states.sourceLabel: OpenRouter temporary path — not direct Gemini validation
states.accessibilityHint: Two upload slots for synthetic screenshots. Both must be filled before extraction begins.
states.safetyConstraint: Synthetic images only. No real PII. No external upload to any service. The OpenRouter temporary-path label must be visible.

states.heading: Upload Validation Error
states.body: The uploaded images could not be accepted. Please ensure both files are readable, describe a valid two-leg self-transfer itinerary, and contain no real personal data. You can re-upload or restart the demo.
states.sourceLabel: OpenRouter temporary path — not direct Gemini validation
states.accessibilityHint: Error state after invalid upload. Clear feedback with recovery path.
states.safetyConstraint: No silent acceptance of invalid input. Synthetic-demo context retained. No external calls.

states.heading: Review Extracted Itinerary
states.body: The following itinerary fields were extracted from your synthetic screenshots. All fields are editable. Please review and correct any errors before confirming. This extraction was produced via a temporary OpenRouter path and is not direct Gemini validation.
states.sourceLabel: OpenRouter temporary path — not direct Gemini validation
states.accessibilityHint: Editable form showing extracted itinerary fields beside source screenshots. All fields can be corrected.
states.safetyConstraint: No downstream risk calculation or Atlas search may start before explicit confirmation. The OpenRouter temporary-path label must be visible. Fields are unconfirmed until the user acts.

states.heading: Review Corrected Itinerary
states.body: You have corrected one or more extracted fields. Please review all fields and confirm when satisfied. Correction notes are recorded locally. This extraction was produced via a temporary OpenRouter path and is not direct Gemini validation.
states.sourceLabel: OpenRouter temporary path — not direct Gemini validation
states.accessibilityHint: Editable form with corrected fields highlighted. Correction notes visible.
states.safetyConstraint: No downstream action before explicit confirmation. Corrections are local only. The OpenRouter temporary-path label must remain visible.

states.heading: Itinerary Confirmed
states.body: The itinerary has been confirmed. Risk and alternatives panels are now available. No external service call was made. All downstream data is local synthetic placeholder content.
states.sourceLabel: OpenRouter temporary path — not direct Gemini validation
states.accessibilityHint: Confirmation state visible. Downstream panels unlocked.
states.safetyConstraint: Confirmation is the single gate. No external calls triggered by confirmation. No booking or write action. The OpenRouter temporary-path label remains visible.

states.heading: Connection Risk
states.body: Confirm itinerary first
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Nosana evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Risk panel is disabled. It will activate after the itinerary is confirmed.
states.safetyConstraint: Panel is non-interactive until confirmation. Exact disabled text: Confirm itinerary first. No risk data shown.

states.heading: Safer Alternatives
states.body: Confirm itinerary first
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Atlas Sandbox evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Alternatives panel is disabled. It will activate after the itinerary is confirmed.
states.safetyConstraint: Panel is non-interactive until confirmation. Exact disabled text: Confirm itinerary first. No alternatives data shown.

states.heading: Connection Risk — Heuristic Result
states.body: Risk band: medium. This is a heuristic risk estimate only, derived from a static/historical synthetic dataset. It is not a live delay prediction, weather model, legal assessment, or guaranteed outcome. The connection duration at this synthetic airport profile falls in the medium band of the demo dataset.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Nosana evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Risk result panel showing heuristic band and plain-language explanation. Disclaimer visible.
states.safetyConstraint: Labelled as heuristic, not a guarantee. Labelled as synthetic local placeholder, not Nosana evidence. No booking or write action.

states.heading: Connection Risk — Unavailable
states.body: No risk band could be produced for this itinerary. The connection airport is absent from the synthetic static dataset slice, so no score is available. No score has been invented. You may re-run the risk assessment or proceed without risk guidance.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Nosana evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Risk unavailable state. No score shown. Replay and proceed options available.
states.safetyConstraint: No score invented. Clearly labelled as unavailable. Synthetic local placeholder label visible.

states.heading: Connection Risk — Error
states.body: The risk assessment could not be completed. A validation error occurred before any workload could start. You can retry the assessment or replay a previous result if available.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Nosana evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Risk error state with retry path. No score shown.
states.safetyConstraint: No silent failure. No invented score. Synthetic local placeholder label visible. Error is understandable.

states.heading: Connection Risk — Timeout
states.body: The risk assessment did not complete within the expected time. No risk band or score is available and none has been invented. You can retry the assessment or use a labelled replay of a previous result if available.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Nosana evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Risk timeout state with retry and replay paths. No score shown.
states.safetyConstraint: No score invented on timeout. Clearly labelled timeout state. Synthetic local placeholder label visible.

states.heading: Connection Risk — Workload Failure
states.body: The risk assessment workload failed before producing a result. No risk band or score is available and none has been invented. You can retry the assessment or use a labelled replay of a previous result if available.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Nosana evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Risk workload failure state with retry and replay paths. No score shown.
states.safetyConstraint: No score invented on failure. Clearly labelled failure state. Synthetic local placeholder label visible.

states.heading: Safer Alternatives — Sandbox Results
states.body: The following alternatives were returned from a local synthetic placeholder search. These are not Atlas Sandbox evidence. All results are fictional and for demo display only. Atlas content is search-only; no booking, payment, or order is created.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Atlas Sandbox evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Alternatives panel showing synthetic placeholder results. Each alternative labelled as sandbox data.
states.safetyConstraint: Labelled as synthetic local placeholder, not Atlas Sandbox evidence. Search-only. No write actions. offerReference is display-only.

states.heading: Safer Alternatives — No Results
states.body: No safer alternatives were found for this itinerary. This is a local synthetic placeholder result and is not Atlas Sandbox evidence. You can retry the search or proceed with the Keep decision using your current plan.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Atlas Sandbox evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Empty alternatives state. No results fabricated. Retry option available.
states.safetyConstraint: No alternatives fabricated. Clearly labelled empty state. Synthetic local placeholder label visible. Keep remains available.

states.heading: Safer Alternatives — Search Error
states.body: The alternative search could not be completed. This is a local synthetic placeholder error and is not Atlas Sandbox evidence. You can retry the search or replay a previous result if available.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Atlas Sandbox evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Alternatives error state with retry path. No results fabricated.
states.safetyConstraint: No alternatives fabricated on error. Clearly labelled error state. Synthetic local placeholder label visible.

states.heading: Safer Alternatives — Search Timeout
states.body: The alternative search did not complete within the expected time. This is a local synthetic placeholder timeout and is not Atlas Sandbox evidence. You can retry the search or replay a previous result if available.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Atlas Sandbox evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Alternatives timeout state with retry and replay paths. No results fabricated.
states.safetyConstraint: No alternatives fabricated on timeout. Clearly labelled timeout state. Synthetic local placeholder label visible.

states.heading: Compare: Risky Self-Transfer vs Safer Alternatives
states.body: Below is a side-by-side comparison of your current self-transfer plan against available alternatives. All data is synthetic and local. Risk data is a heuristic placeholder. Alternatives are sandbox placeholders. No booking or order is created by viewing this comparison.
states.sourceLabel: Synthetic local placeholder — not Atlas Sandbox evidence
states.accessibilityHint: Side-by-side comparison table. Original plan on the left, alternatives on the right. All source labels visible.
states.safetyConstraint: Both risk and alternatives labels visible. No booking or write action. Comparison uses only labelled synthetic data.

states.heading: Your Decision: Keep
states.body: You have chosen to Keep your current self-transfer plan. This is a local demo decision only. No booking, payment, reservation, ticket, order, verification, or any other external action has been created or will be created.
states.accessibilityHint: Keep decision selected. Final confirmation states no external action occurs.
states.safetyConstraint: No booking, payment, reservation, ticket, order, verification, or write action. Decision is local only. Final statement must explicitly deny any external action.

states.heading: Your Decision: Switch
states.body: You have chosen to Switch to a safer alternative. This is a local demo decision only. No booking, payment, reservation, ticket, order, verification, or any other external action has been created or will be created. The selected alternative is a synthetic placeholder only.
states.accessibilityHint: Switch decision selected with a synthetic alternative reference. Final confirmation states no external action occurs.
states.safetyConstraint: No booking, payment, reservation, ticket, order, verification, or write action. Decision is local only. Selected alternative is display-only.

states.heading: Demo Complete — No Action Created
states.body: Your decision has been recorded. This is the end of the StitchCheck synthetic demo. Explicitly: no booking, payment, reservation, ticket, order, verification, or any other write action has been created. All data displayed was synthetic and local. No live service was called.
states.accessibilityHint: Final confirmation screen. States clearly that no external action was created. Restart option available.
states.safetyConstraint: Must explicitly state no booking, payment, reservation, ticket, order, verification, or write action. noOrderCreated: true. syntheticDemo: true.

states.heading: Loading
states.body: Processing your request. Please wait.
states.accessibilityHint: Generic loading banner. Visible during data processing or state transitions.
states.safetyConstraint: No external calls implied. Loading is local state only.

states.heading: Status
states.body: Operation in progress. All data is synthetic and local.
states.accessibilityHint: Generic status banner for informational messages during the demo flow.
states.safetyConstraint: No service claims. Status is local state only.

states.heading: Error
states.body: An error occurred. No external service was called. You can retry the operation or restart the demo.
states.accessibilityHint: Generic error banner with retry and restart options. Understandable without color alone.
states.safetyConstraint: No silent failure. No external calls implied. Error is understandable and recoverable.
